IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Sunday 8 November
Winds: Southeasterly below 10 knots.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Monday 9 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming east to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots in the middle of the day then tending north to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, decreasing below 0.5 metres during the morning, then increasing to around 1 metre around midday.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Tuesday 10 November
Winds: North to northwesterly about 10 knots tending southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the morning then turning south to southwesterly in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny morning. 50% chance of showers in the late afternoon and evening.

Wednesday 11 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots turning west to northwesterly below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 12 November
Winds: Northwesterly below 10 knots tending southeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day then tending southerly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system will drift eastwards across the state today, and away to the southeast from Monday. A trough is expected to move over from the west on Tuesday evening, closely followed by a ridge on Wednesday. The ridge is forecast to remain over Tasmania on Thursday.
